blocks:onboarding-welcome.title: Onboarding Welcome
blocks:onboarding-welcome.description: The opening onboarding split: blue character field, bounded step count, one setup promise, and no more than two actions.

blocks:role-persona-selector.title: Role Persona Selector
blocks:role-persona-selector.description: A five-role onboarding choice with a shared pink people field, explicit setup effect, direct progress, reusable radio behavior, and one gated continuation.

blocks:workspace-setup.title: Workspace Setup
blocks:workspace-setup.description: A blue task-first setup step for workspace identity, URL, and optional initial invitations using the shared onboarding rhythm and form controls.

blocks:integration-selector.title: Integration Connector Grid
blocks:integration-selector.description: A blue connector step with six real tool objects, clear available, connected, and coming-soon states, direct actions, and a plain connected count.

blocks:interest-tag-picker.title: Interest Tag Picker
blocks:interest-tag-picker.description: A grouped multi-select for prioritizing product work, system craft, and output examples without introducing AI-specific or unrelated topic filler.

blocks:goal-selector.title: Goal Selector
blocks:goal-selector.description: A multi-select onboarding decision with one yellow orientation field, neutral selectable objects, explicit progress, visible selection count, and gated continuation.

blocks:notification-preferences.title: Notification Preferences
blocks:notification-preferences.description: A yellow task-first notification step with two ruled groups, shared switch fields, an enabled count, and one save action plus quiet escape route.

blocks:profile-setup.title: Profile Setup
blocks:profile-setup.description: A pink people-context step with photo upload, identity fields, timezone, shared progress, one save action, and no form-card wrapper.

blocks:template-starter-picker.title: Template Starter Picker
blocks:template-starter-picker.description: A yellow starting-shape choice using one shared radio grid, five ordinary project templates, one meaningful recommendation status, and gated creation.

blocks:onboarding-completion-screen.title: Onboarding Completion Screen
blocks:onboarding-completion-screen.description: A restrained completion split with one green character story, rare milestone seal, short setup summary, one primary first task, and one workspace route.

blocks:security-setup.title: Security Setup
blocks:security-setup.description: A deep-blue protected-access step with a flat safeguard sequence, exact completion count, recovery and two-factor actions, and a quiet defer route.

blocks:keyboard-shortcuts-cheat-sheet.title: Keyboard Shortcuts Cheat Sheet
blocks:keyboard-shortcuts-cheat-sheet.description: A flat, partitioned shortcut reference for the few commands worth learning during onboarding, with a restrained finish action.

blocks:data-import-selector.title: Data Import Selector
blocks:data-import-selector.description: A blue task-first import decision with shared radio options for connected tools, file upload, or a clean workspace and one gated continuation.

blocks:attribution-survey.title: Attribution Survey
blocks:attribution-survey.description: An optional pink context step with six plain discovery sources, one conditional text field, visible feedback, and no nested channel questionnaire.

blocks:billing-cycle-setup.title: Billing Cycle Setup
blocks:billing-cycle-setup.description: A deep-blue billing-review step with one cycle control, exact recurring amount, payment-method choice, optional coupon feedback, and one confirmation action.

blocks:company-info-form.title: Company Info Form
blocks:company-info-form.description: A blue task-first context step for team name, size, industry, and role using shared controls and the canonical onboarding progress and action rhythm.

blocks:feature-tour-carousel.title: Feature Tour
blocks:feature-tour-carousel.description: A focused onboarding tour with one Marker-led introduction, one pastel feature surface, a short ruled benefit list, and reusable carousel controls.
